values.meaning: bonus physical damage on next attack

values.quote: After a 2-second delay, he also becomes {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}}

mechanics.claim: The ability's duration starts on cast, and cooldown starts after the effect ends.
mechanics.quote: ''Thrill of the Hunt's'' duration starts on-cast.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage attack is a separate cast/damage instance from the normal basic attack, potentially allowing an extra stack of on-hit/proc effects like Eclipse or Electrocute.
mechanics.quote: It is also part of a separate {{tip|cast instance}} - potentially allowing an extra stack of {{ii|Eclipse}} and {{ri|Electrocute}} (e.g while using {{ii|Black Cleaver}}).

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage deals basic damage (can be blocked, subject to same reductions as basic attacks) and can trigger on-hit-like effects.
Attacking or casting other abilities (except Savagery) ends Thrill of the Hunt immediately, removing the pending bonus damage effect if not yet applied.
mechanics.quote: Attacking or casting [[champion ability|abilities]] other than ''{{ai|Savagery|Rengar}}'' ends ''Thrill of the Hunt'' immediately.

mechanics.claim: A mark is applied at the start of attack windup and consumed when the attack lands to grant the bonus damage; if the attack is blocked, the effect does not apply.
mechanics.quote: The ability applies a mark on the target at the start of {{tip|attack windup}} that is successively consumed when the basic attack hits to apply the effect.
